subject.title: fix(agents): add tool-use terminal continuation for codex app-server toolUse stops

question: Must this recovery wait for an enforceable Codex no-tools continuation mode, or may OpenClaw accept a prompt-only prohibition after side-effecting tools?
rationale: The documented Codex `turn/start` contract does not expose a hard built-in-tools-disabled override, so implementation review cannot safely choose whether prompt compliance is an acceptable side-effect boundary without owner intent.

options.title: Require hard no-tools enforcement
options.body: Merge only after the Codex owner path can remove callable tools and verify every started item completed before continuation.

options.title: Accept prompt-only enforcement
options.body: Allow the extra fully capable turn and explicitly own the possibility that a model repeats a side-effecting tool despite the instruction.

options.title: Pause for upstream support
options.body: Keep the current fail-closed behavior until Codex exposes a supported tool-disabled continuation capability.

recommendation.title: Require hard no-tools enforcement
recommendation.body: Merge only after the Codex owner path can remove callable tools and verify every started item completed before continuation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned owner on the adjacent Codex terminal-notification hardening track and are best positioned to choose the runtime boundary.
